title: Looking after my friend's chihuahua. Apparently I forgot to ask my dachshund first.
author: Sea_Cherry_5570
blurb: A visiting chihuahua has taken the comfiest spot on the blanket, while the resident long-haired doxie peers from behind with a very unimpressed side-eye. Their human admits they forgot to ask the dachshund before agreeing to dog-sit.
